title: Bach two-voice counterpoint (or similar)
purpose: forcing function for voice-leading. Two melodic lines played independently, frequently sounding simultaneously. Interim rule classifies the simultaneous moments as chord; voice-leading-aware classification recognizes two voices in melodic motion.
expected_prose:
Both lines are melody. No chord events
during simultaneous-but-melodic passages.

**Expected (interim):** Many false-positive chord classifications
when the two voices happen to harmonize into recognized triads.
Documented as expected failure.
pending_reason: To be transcribed from a Bach two-part invention or similar. Pending.
